summary: Verified admin login bug fix and new Invoice Verify page. All 4 demo-login buttons (admin→/admin, partner→/partner, merchant→/merchant, customer→/account) work without any 'Demo login failed' or 'Connection issue' toasts. Manual OTP flow (login-phone-input + send-otp-button + otp-box-0..5 + Verify OTP) also works. Verify page returns 200 with data-testid=verify-status-genuine and renders INV-2026-000001, partner receipt INV-2026-000001-P, masked customer 'P**** V****', CGST@9% ₹12.01, SGST@9% ₹12.00, Tax Invoice ₹157.38, Partner Receipt ₹433.48, Total Paid ₹590.86. Bad signature returns 404 with data-testid=verify-status-invalid. Mobile 390px layout has no horizontal overflow. Customer invoice /view HTML embeds a QR data URI that decodes (pyzbar) to the signed /api/invoices/verify/{id}?s={sig} URL and that URL in turn verifies as genuine. Preview sample has no verify_url (QR stays text as expected).
critical_code_review_comments: Verify signature is only 24 hex chars (truncated hash). This is fine for a public tamper check against invoice_id, but it is derived purely from JWT_SECRET + invoice_id so URLs never expire — consider adding an expiry/issued-at claim or rotating secret if long-lived public links are a concern.

Admin login breakage was caused by REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL mismatch between web_panel/.env and the user's host. Consider centralising this in a single env or deriving the API base from window.location when they match (production), to prevent future hosting-domain drift from killing demo logins.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (demo logins + manual OTP + verify page genuine/invalid + mobile layout)

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter175 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter175_verify_qr.py pins: (a) all three demo OTP logins return a token; (b) /api/invoices/verify/{id}?s=... returns 200 for the valid signature e00ad16b124d71d4bbbd1170 against invoice 4bc7ebb5-...-f25 and 404 for a wrong signature; (c) customer /api/invoices/{id}/view HTML includes a base64 PNG QR that decodes to the same signed verify URL. pyzbar+libzbar0 are installed in this env. The valid signature in /app/test_reports/verify_url.txt stays stable until JWT_SECRET changes.
rca of the issue: Admin login failure RCA: /app/web_panel was built-time baked against a different preview host via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Browser requests to /api/auth/send-otp went to the stale host → blocked by ingress → toast 'Connection issue. Reconnecting' and 'Demo login failed'. Fix (already applied by E1): unify REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://pm-backend-frontend.preview.emergentagent.com across backend/.env, frontend/.env and web_panel/.env and restart. Verified no more error toasts on any demo button and manual OTP.
